_comment: FM-1 pre-migration snapshot lock for EDGE-GOVT-SAL. Two assertions in schemaFixtureFactory.test.ts: (1) live hand-written EDGE_GOVT_SAL.payload in formPathScenarios.ts deep-equals this snapshot; (2) toScenario(EDGE_GOVT_SAL_JOURNEY).payload deep-equals this snapshot. Both must pass before Step-5 in-place rewrites.
_source: src/lib/testing/scenarios/formPathScenarios.ts :: EDGE_GOVT_SAL.payload (rewritten 2026-04-22 to match buildLoanPayload output from EDGE_GOVT_SAL_JOURNEY).
_shift_notes_S77e_step4: Classification (i) FIXTURE-WAS-WRONG — hand-written scenario used idealized payload keys that the current LAP schema + builder cannot produce. Corrections: (1) q2_LAPType formPath value 'Term Loan' is not a valid schema option — LAPType options are 'LAP' and 'Drop-line OverDraft (DOD)'. Journey uses 'LAP'. The formPath field is not part of the buildLoanPayload output so this drift only appears in the hand-written scenario; the payload-layer snapshot is unaffected. (2) propertyType 'Commercial' REMOVED — LAP's q3_propertyType binds propertyType to ownership-type values ('Free Hold'/'Lease Hold'). Category is carried separately (not surfaced to payload in LAP). (3) constructionStatus 'Ready to Move' → 'Shop' — builder maps constructionType answer → constructionStatus, and 'Shop' is the chosen commercial construction type. (4) propertyIdentified: true → false — LAP schema has no propertyIdentified question, so builder's toBoolean(undefined) yields false. (5) carpetArea + carpetAreaUnit + carpetAreaRaw normalized. (6) societyStatus + floodDisasterZone + approachRoadWidth + restrictedZone + zoneClassification + municipalTaxStatus + propertyAcquisitionMethod + applicantResidingInProperty + propertyOccupancyStatus + existingEncumbrance + originalDocumentsAvailable + ownershipChainComplete + noLegalDispute + encumbranceCertificateVerified added — these are real schema keys that flow through for the OLD_MUNICIPAL commercial path. (7) titleChainStatus / encumbranceCertStatus REMOVED — those keys are produced by Home Loan's complianceLegal_homeLoan questions, not by LAP's propertyLegal_LAP (which uses ownershipChainComplete / encumbranceCertificateVerified). (8) shopEstablishmentLicense is asked (answered VALID) but does not surface to payload — the builder does not currently map it. (9) applicantResidingInProperty: 'No' + propertyOccupancyStatus: 'commercial_use' flow through because the applicant does not reside at the LAP'd commercial property. (10) hasExistingObligations: false (no obligations in journey).
_shift_notes_bugA_fix_2026_05_28: Session 2 BUG-A / Plot Construction sizing fix (2026-05-28 late-evening): `buildLoanTransactionPayload` in payloadBuilder/loanTransaction.ts now derives loanAmount in a type-aware way:   • Balance Transfer Only        → principalOutstanding   • Top-up Only                  → topUpAmount   • Balance Transfer With Top-up → principalOutstanding + topUpAmount   • Plot Loan BT (via PlotLoanActivity flag) → principalOutstanding   • Construction Loan Only       → requiredExtraAmount - downPayment   • Plot & Construction Loan     → (propCost + requiredExtraAmount) - downPayment   • everything else              → existing RequiredLoanAmount / loanAmount / sanctionAmount chain Before the fix, BT-Only/Top-up-Only/BT+Topup all fell through to either sanctionAmount (Top-up) or the propertyCost-downPayment fallback (BT-Only), evaluating the customer against the wrong amount → false RED rejections across every lender. Plot Construction loans were similarly mis-sized, either under-requesting (Construction Only) or under-valuing the LTV base (Plot & Construction). For Plot Construction variants, propertyCost now also includes the construction cost so LTV caps fire against the full project value. Field SHAPE unchanged — only loanAmount + propertyCost VALUES move.
_shift_notes_lend_2026_06_02: LEND-1 session 2026-06-02 — two concurrent payload-builder fixes: (1) Phase 1b (ADR-0025): Plot & Equity Loan canonical-field aliasing — propCost → marketValue, agreementSellValue → registryValue, derived sellerCashComponent (= marketValue − registryValue). Gated on loanVariant === "Plot & Equity Loan", affects PLOT-EQUITY only. (2) propertyIdentified force-true for Plot Loan + LAP — neither form asks the question, so the prior coercion to false hid real Plot/LAP deals from downstream consumers. Affects 5 LAP snapshots + 2 LAP-EDGE snapshots. Plot snapshots already had propertyIdentified=true (set via journey fixtures) so they need no field-value flip — but PLOT-EQUITY still needs regen for the new aliased fields. Home Loan paths are unaffected by both.
